Lopāmudrā
------------------------------------------
Lopāmudrā was the wife of the famous sage अगस्त्य. (See AGASTYA for details.) She was the daughter of the king of the Vidarbha country.
According to one story, अगस्त्य once saw his forefathers in a miserable condition. On enquiry, they advised him to marry and beget sons who would deliver them from this misery. He then approached the king of Vidarbha and requested him to give his daughter लोपामुद्रा in मर्रिअगे. Though the king was hesitant, लोपामुद्रा herself came forward accepting the proposal.
The two were married at the place called Mahāsindhutīrtha.
Dṛḍhasyu (or इध्मवाह) was their son.
She was also known as सत्यवती. She is sometimes identified with कावेरी, daughter of the sage Kavera, who became the river कावेरी.
